'''Ben Phillips''' (also credited as '''Aaron Phillips''') is a voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is currently affiliated with Atlas Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Phillips was born on August 27, 1980 in Fort Worth, Texas, and became a voice actor as an adult. Phillips joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where he gained his most notable role of [[Hobbes]], {{an|Lillie}}'s butler.
